title: Allosteric inhibition of SHP2 phosphatase inhibits cancers driven by receptor tyrosine kinases
text: SHP099 is a potent, selective allosteric SHP2 inhibitor that blocks RAS-MAPK signalling and shows antitumour activity in RTK-driven and KRAS-mutant models.

title: SHP2 inhibition restores sensitivity to MEK inhibitors in KRAS-mutant lung cancer
text: Combined SHP2 and MEK inhibition produced durable regressions in KRAS-mutant NSCLC xenografts, supporting SHP099-class agents as combination partners.

title: Adaptive resistance to SHP2 inhibition in KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer
text: SHP099 monotherapy failed to sustain pathway suppression in KRAS-mutant colorectal models, with rapid MAPK reactivation and no significant tumour growth inhibition.

title: First-in-human study of TNO155, an allosteric SHP2 inhibitor, in advanced solid tumours
text: TNO155 was tolerable with target engagement demonstrated in paired biopsies; single-agent activity was modest and combination cohorts were opened.

title: Adagrasib in KRAS G12C-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer
text: Adagrasib produced durable responses in pretreated KRAS G12C NSCLC with intracranial activity, confirming covalent switch-II inhibition as a valid strategy.

title: Clinical resistance to sotorasib through KRAS amplification and MAPK reactivation
text: Acquired resistance to sotorasib in colorectal cancer involved KRAS amplification and MAPK reactivation; response rates were markedly lower than in lung cancer.

title: RMC-4550 is an allosteric SHP2 inhibitor with limited single-agent activity in colorectal models
text: RMC-4550 engaged SHP2 but did not inhibit pERK in DLD1 colorectal xenografts at tolerated exposures, indicating context-dependent activity.

title: Osimertinib in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer
text: Osimertinib showed superior efficacy over first-generation EGFR inhibitors with activity against T790M, establishing it as standard of care.
